description: This file defines an abstract base class for audio resampling implementations in the Pipecat project, establishing a standard interface for converting audio data between different sample rates.

classes.name: BaseAudioResampler
classes.description: Abstract base class for audio resampling implementations, providing a standardized interface for converting audio data between sample rates.

methods.name: bytes resample(self, audio: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int)
methods.description: Abstract asynchronous method to resample audio data from one sample rate to another. Must be implemented in subclasses.
